tldr: Anthropic shipped Claude Ship, which lets agents fix failing checks and approve routine pull requests. OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a free Linux runtime that lets agents block attacks while patches ship. ChatGPT's default model is now GPT-6.2 Sol, with much better image reading. Anthropic pays xAI about 3.1 billion dollars a month for compute, and xAI is cutting its own projects. Nvidia put Jensen Huang back as chief executive after about two weeks.

articles.title: Anthropic ships Claude Ship: agents fix and approve pull requests
articles.summary: Code Review is now GA, plus PR Steward and Claude Approvals, which can approve routine pull requests on Team and Enterprise.

articles.title: OpenAI and Cisco open source Shirudo, an agent-written eBPF shield
articles.summary: A free Linux runtime from OpenAI and Cisco lets agents write eBPF controls so defenders can patch without downtime.

articles.title: GPT-6.2 Sol becomes the default ChatGPT model, image reading at 71.7 percent
articles.summary: OpenAI makes GPT-6.2 Sol the default in ChatGPT's chat tab, lifting image understanding from 47.4 to 71.7 percent.

articles.title: Anthropic pays xAI about 3.1 billion dollars a month for compute
articles.summary: Anthropic pays xAI about $3.1B a month and Google $800M, as xAI rents out capacity and scales back its own AI work.

articles.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive
articles.summary: Nvidia's board brings Jensen Huang back as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately, after a two-week gap.

articles.title: RoboTrack tracks points across frames for real-world robot manipulation
articles.summary: Allen Institute's RoboTrack follows the same point through a scene, aimed at robots handling real objects rather than clean demos.

articles.title: Chinese military researchers fear AI could expose mobile nuclear missiles
articles.summary: Chinese military researchers warn AI advances could hand the US an edge in finding and targeting mobile nuclear launchers.

articles.title: Import AI 482: Huawei kernel benchmarks, drone detection, an AI science benchmark
articles.summary: Huawei's kernel benchmark results, airborne drone detection work, and a national lab's benchmark for AI doing science.

articles.title: Management consulting is not a thin wrapper on intelligence
articles.summary: Consulting is used as a test case for how AI actually lands on knowledge work, and why the wrapper framing misses the job.

articles.title: GLM-5.4: Z.ai's looped transformer claims 2T-class results at 750B
articles.summary: 28 of the model's layers run twice per token, 1M context, live on the GLM Coding Plan. No benchmarks yet, API held back, open weights promised later.

articles.title: Google can block an agent's tool call before it runs
articles.summary: New semantic governance policies let admins deny a tool call up front, instead of spotting the damage after the agent has already acted.

articles.title: A coding agent committed the key behind Together AI's prompt leak
articles.summary: Together's post-mortem says a coding agent committed the credential that let others read prompts from June and July requests.

articles.title: X Square's WALL-OSS-1.0 hits 55.1 percent zero-shot on 312 robot tasks
articles.summary: Open-source vision-language-action model posts 55.1 percent zero-shot across 312 manipulation tasks, shown driving real robot arms.

articles.title: Ant opens MIT-licensed medical models at 560B and 124B
articles.summary: LingSante-3.1-air-VL is a vision-language medical model released under a fully permissive licence, the largest open medical drop yet.

articles.title: NVIDIA's Alpamayo 2 Edge puts a 2B reasoning model on car silicon
articles.summary: A 2B vision-language-action model that reasons before acting, built for DRIVE Thor, so the reasoning runs in the vehicle and not the cloud.

articles.title: GameWM turns player input into playable game worlds
articles.summary: New paper builds an interaction-centric world model, generating game environments that respond to how you play instead of pre-rendered video.

articles.title: AlphaAnything gives open image generators a real alpha channel
articles.summary: Extends pretrained RGB generators to RGBA output, so open models can produce transparent-background images without a separate matting pass.

articles.title: Visa CLI lets a card verify an AI agent that then pays in stablecoin
articles.summary: A US Visa card passes a one-time bank check, the agent gets a signing key in Visa's directory, and pays OUSD on Tempo. Not a KYC check.

articles.title: A beginner's guide to local AI with Inkling, Qwen and Unsloth
articles.summary: Practical walkthrough of running open models at home with Unsloth quantisation, written for people starting from nothing.

articles.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
articles.summary: OpenAI argues perplexity is a useful yardstick for model progress and that developers need shared ways to measure new capabilities.

articles.title: Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers
articles.summary: OpenRouter documents data processing incidents across inference providers, a reminder to check where routed prompts actually land.

articles.title: METR warns AI is getting better faster than experts can reliably test whether new systems are safe
articles.summary: METR says leading models improve faster than tests can track them, and current data cannot rule out a dangerous acceleration.

articles.title: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search into a nonstop watchdog
articles.summary: Perplexity's Monitor API searches on a schedule and only pings agents by webhook when something relevant actually changes.

articles.title: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
articles.summary: A workplace simulation finds coding agents finish fewer than one in ten messy real-world tasks, even Opus 5.5 and Astra.

articles.title: US tech stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up
articles.summary: Nasdaq 100 slides into a bear market; Nvidia drops 14 percent as the SEC reviews its accounting and AI doubts spread.

articles.title: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
articles.summary: ByteDance and US universities release Axion 1.0, an open agent model matching top commercial systems after only three training phases.

articles.title: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis
articles.summary: The Lean community publishes its machine-checked verification of the Riemann Hypothesis proof, confirmed by independent verifiers.

articles.title: OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions
articles.summary: OpenAI posts prompt templates for GPT-6.2 models to cut terse answers, needless follow-up questions and over-testing in code.

articles.title: Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
articles.summary: A New Yorker report on a Vermont monastery building its own AI god draws tech money, as former members raise alarms.

articles.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
articles.summary: Nvidia researchers say long context is slow, costly and error-prone, and periodic summaries plus keyword search usually match it.

articles.title: Hermes Enterprise arrives on Microsoft Foundry with a real work account per agent
articles.summary: Each Hermes instance gets its own Entra account, mailbox, OneDrive and manager, so IT governs it like staff. Autonomous mode is preview-only.

articles.title: Hermes Agent v0.23.3 rolls up about 370 PRs and changes two defaults
articles.summary: Prompt-cache lifecycle control, compaction that archives dropped tool results, and the proactive tool-result prune now on by default.

articles.title: Mistral opens its Asia Pacific headquarters in Singapore
articles.summary: An extended science hub for sovereign AI in public sector, manufacturing and robotics, with APAC headcount to double to 200 by 2027.

articles.title: House report says Cursor may drop Chinese open-weight models
articles.summary: A House report pushes Cursor to weigh dropping PRC weights on geopolitical risk. Composer 2 runs on Moonshot Kimi, so the exposure is real.

articles.title: ChatGPT opens agent publishing to businesses outside the US
articles.summary: Non-US merchants and service businesses can claim their listing and publish an agent, so a Singapore shop no longer needs a US entity.

articles.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
articles.summary: Paper on models that edit their own weights directly, a step past in-context learning toward agents that keep changing themselves.

articles.title: Thinking Machines ships Inkling 2 Mini, a 20GB model that runs locally
articles.summary: A small open model that fits on a laptop and still leads the under-100B class, topped Hacker News all day.

articles.title: OpenAI cuts its own reasoning leaks from 54 percent to 0.2 percent
articles.summary: New safeguards against distillation attacks combine training, detection and account enforcement.

articles.title: A new benchmark tests whether AI can actually pick a drug candidate
articles.summary: MedChemBench scores models on reading molecular structures and reasoning from lab evidence.

articles.title: A 940-page human-only proof of the Riemann Hypothesis lands hours after Claude's
articles.summary: Alessandro Masullo published a machine-free proof, giving mathematicians a human baseline to check.

articles.title: Aaronson: the stochastic parrots have apparently proved the Riemann Hypothesis
articles.summary: The blogger's read on what an AI proof of math's hardest problem does and does not settle.

articles.title: China's AI-exposed roles are shrinking faster than the rest of the job market
articles.summary: Bloomberg read 10 million postings: entry-level and creative work fell hardest, and 90% of micro-dramas are AI-made.

articles.title: Apple joins the device-agent race while tightening the door behind it
articles.summary: Apple is building an agent that drives its own devices, after Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google shipped theirs.

articles.title: Nvidia bets at least $500M on Inception's diffusion language models
articles.summary: The two-year-old startup generates text by diffusion rather than token by token, feeding Nvidia's Nemotron line.

articles.title: Signal blocks screenshots so AI agents cannot read your private chats
articles.summary: Signal calls device agents an existential threat to privacy, but admits its block is incomplete on macOS.

articles.title: DeepSeek raises OpenRouter prices, up to 233 percent on V4.1 Flash
articles.summary: V4 Pro output doubles to $9.50 per million tokens and V4.1 Flash output triples, ending the cheap-token era.

articles.title: Hermes plugin hackathon winners open a curated marketplace
articles.summary: Nearly 1,000 entries were scored by agents, then ranked by five judges; top picks install from the Marketplace.

articles.title: Hugging Face ships harness adapters to swap models between agent harnesses
articles.summary: One adapter layer lets the same model run across different agent stacks instead of being rewritten per harness.

articles.title: Hebbia reports better financial research with GPT-6 Astra
articles.summary: The research startup measured gains in source coverage, citation relevance and presentation quality.

articles.title: Google moves its homepage further toward an AI answer engine
articles.summary: Search now leads with a generated answer rather than a list of links, the clearest shift yet from the ten-blue-links model.

articles.title: DeepSeek closes a 100 billion yuan round and prepares a Shanghai listing
articles.summary: About 15 billion dollars, with new investors taking a 17.3 percent stake. Caixin says a STAR Market IPO is being prepared.

articles.title: Tencent releases Hy4 open weights: 770B parameters, 1M context
articles.summary: 770B total, 49B active, text, image and video in, day-one vLLM support. Listed at 0.83 dollars input and 2.50 output per million tokens.

articles.title: An AI designed a CPU architecture end to end, and it hits 4.59x performance per watt
articles.summary: Architect Labs says Frostbite was discovered, designed and verified by AI, not just assisted by it.

articles.title: European Commission confirms an AI tool drove the hack on its own systems
articles.summary: The Commission said the intrusion on its own infrastructure was carried out with the help of an AI tool.

articles.title: "I can tell you wrote this yourself"
articles.summary: On telling human writing from machine writing, and what that test is really measuring. 205 points on Hacker News.

articles.title: Apple's Depth Pro 2 reads metric depth from a photo or live video
articles.summary: Four sizes from 24M to 872M parameters give per-pixel depth in metres that stays steady between frames. Research-only licence.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Neon tops a new engineering benchmark index at 68.1
articles.summary: The Models Engineering Index ranks 20 models on engineering tasks: Claude Fable 5.2 second at 66.3, GPT-6.2 Astra third at 62.0.

articles.title: Genie 4 opens to developers through the Gemini API and AI Studio
articles.summary: 720p interactive worlds at 24fps with stereo audio, steerable by keyboard and live prompts, at about 10 cents per second of output.

articles.title: Reuters shows Meta Muse reading Signal messages through OS permissions
articles.summary: Early safety incidents at Meta's agent, including reading private messages on a device it was given access to.

articles.title: Gemini can now drive your Mac, and Apple is building a rival agent
articles.summary: Google gives Gemini control of a desktop session. Apple is reported to be working on its own version.

points.text: Hermes now runs inside Microsoft Foundry, and each agent gets its own staff account.
Hermes Agent v0.23.3 quietly turned on two settings that cut token cost on long chats.
Google put Genie 4 on its developer API, so anyone can generate interactive worlds.
Alibaba and Tencent both shipped cheaper models with a million-token memory.
Cloudflare gave away weights for a model that turns documents into clean data.
Z.ai shipped GLM-5.4, a model that runs part of its own network twice to think harder without adding parameters.
Google can now block an AI agent's tool call before it runs.
A coding agent committed the key behind Together AI's summer prompt leak.
Two small open models landed, one for robots and one for medical text.
A new paper builds playable game worlds from player input, and another gives open image models transparent backgrounds.
Anthropic shipped Claude Ship, which lets agents fix failing checks and approve routine pull requests.
OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a free Linux runtime that lets agents block attacks while patches ship.
ChatGPT's default model is now GPT-6.2 Sol, with much better image reading.
Anthropic pays xAI about 3.1 billion dollars a month for compute, and xAI is cutting its own projects.
Nvidia put Jensen Huang back as chief executive after about two weeks.
